SharpDetect 2.2.0+517a7a43b8cf
  Dynamic analysis framework for .NET. Runs an application or a test suite with a CoreCLR profiler attached and reports observed concurrency issues during the run.

USAGE
  sharpdetect init [options]

DESCRIPTION
  Creates a configuration file for analysis

OPTIONS
  -o|--output       Output file path for the configuration file Default: <AnalysisDescriptor.json>.
  -p|--plugin       Analysis plugin name or plugin type full name. Default: FastTrack. 
  -t|--target       Target application or test assembly (.dll) 
  --test            Treat the target as a test assembly Default: <false>.
  -f|--filter       Test filter expression (requires --test) 
  --runner          Test runner: Mtp (default) | VsTest (requires --test) Choices: "Mtp", "VsTest". 
  --instrument-system-libraries  Instrument system assemblies (System, Microsoft, test frameworks..) Default: <false>.
  --no-stack-traces  Report a single frame for racing accesses instead of a stack trace Default: <false>.
  --stack-trace-depth  Maximum number of frames per collected stack trace. Default: 5. 
  -v|--verbosity    Console output detail. Default: Normal. Choices: "Quiet", "Normal", "Detailed", "Diagnostic". 
  --report          Report file or folder. Default: SharpDetect_Report_<local time>.html in the current directory. 
  --no-report       Do not write report Default: <false>.
  -h|--help         Shows help text. Default: <false>.
